title: 第2章 LGD 的救世主？
slug: 什么叫我鲸吞了lpl的气运
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

陈周整个人僵了一下。

他缓缓低头，看向自己的手。

没有长期熬夜写小说留下的干裂感，没有烟熏出来的发黄指节，手腕也没了那种二十多岁以后隐隐约约的酸痛。

太年轻了。

旁边电脑屏幕还亮着，韩服Rank界面，ID：Tree。

陈周呼吸忽然停顿了一秒。

陈周抬起头，门口站着的是LGD当时的工作人员，脸比记忆里年轻很多，头发也还没秃。

他呆了几秒，脑子里像有什么东西忽然炸开，他又看了眼电脑右下角的时间戳，2016，LGD，春季赛，他回来了，而且回到了自己当年在LGD当替补的时候。

工作人员看他不说话，有点不耐烦，“发什么呆啊？赶紧的。”

“明天打VG，你又不是不知道。”

这两个字一出来，陈周脑子“嗡”地一下。

记忆瞬间翻涌。

2016春季赛。

LGD。

1胜8负。

真·银河战舰，上一年LPL的夏季赛冠军，从T1那挖来了去年的世界第一上单Marin。

春季赛的常规赛赛程过半，银河战舰已经坠机，坠机程度比S5赛季的OMG还要更快更夸张。

S5的OMG好歹到了夏季赛才彻底爆炸，LGD是春季赛常规赛就爆炸了。

MaRin来LPL后状态和队伍完全不兼容。

imp已经开始摆烂。

GodV被世界赛舆论压得喘不过气。

野王Eimy和辅王PYL不仅把自己打成了梗，还连带着LGD也给打成了梗，打成了所谓的乐观天团。

陈周刚想到这里，眼前忽然闪了一下，紧接着，一行半透明的文字，缓缓浮现在视野中央。

【检测到宿主已进入目标时间节点。】

【英雄联盟分区载入完成。】

【LPL气运系统启动。】

陈周瞳孔微微一缩。

下一秒。

大量信息开始疯狂浮现。

【当前赛区：LPL】

【当前时间：2016春季赛】

【当前战队：LGDGaming】

【系统核心逻辑：影响力差值模型】

【宿主影响力越高，LPL整体影响力越低，系统增幅越强。】

紧接着。

一串数据跳了出来。

【LPL赛区影响力：73】

【宿主个人影响力：3】

【当前气运差值：-70】

【当前阶段：低谷期】

【系统状态：未激活】

陈周皱起眉。

“什么意思？”

下一秒。

新的文字浮现。

【系统核心公式：】

【宿主影响力-LPL整体影响力=气运差值】

【差值越高，系统奖励越强。】

【差值达到对应阈值，可解锁能力。】

陈周一开始还有点懵，但很快，他脸色开始变得古怪。

因为他突然发现，这系统的逻辑非常有病。

自己越强。

系统奖励越多。

可问题是如果自己真的帮LPL赢了，那LPL影响力也会跟着上涨。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Chen Zhou froze for a moment.

He slowly lowered his head and looked at his hands.

There is no dryness and cracking left by staying up late to write a novel for a long time, there is no yellow knuckles caused by smoke, and there is no longer the vague soreness in my wrists that I experienced after I was in my twenties.

Too young.

The computer screen next to me is still on, the Korean server Rank interface, ID: Tree.

Chen Zhou's breathing suddenly paused for a second.

Chen Zhou raised his head. Standing at the door was a staff member of LGD at that time. His face was much younger than in his memory, and his hair was not bald yet.

He stayed for a few seconds, and something suddenly exploded in his mind. He looked at the timestamp in the lower right corner of the computer, 2016, LGD, Spring Split. He was back, and he was back when he was a substitute in LGD.

The staff looked a little impatient when he didn't speak, "Why are you so dazed? Hurry up."

"I'll play VG tomorrow. It's not like you don't know."

As soon as these two words came out, Chen Zhou's mind buzzed.

Memories surged instantly.

2016 Spring Split.

LGD.

1 win and 8 losses.

True Galaxy Battleship, last year's LPL Summer Split champion, poached last year's world's number one top laner Marin from T1.

Halfway through the regular season schedule of the Spring Split, the Galaxy Battleship has crashed, and the extent of the crash is faster and more exaggerated than OMG in the S5 season.

After all, S5's OMG didn't explode until the summer split, while LGD exploded in the spring regular season.

After MaRin came to LPL, his status was completely incompatible with the team.

The imp has begun to deteriorate.

GodV was overwhelmed by public opinion during the World Championship.

Wild King Eimy and Assistant King PYL not only made themselves a joke, but also made LGD a joke, forming a so-called optimistic team.

When Chen Zhou just thought of this, his eyes suddenly flashed, and then, a line of translucent text slowly appeared in the center of his field of vision.

[It is detected that the host has entered the target time node.】

[The League of Legends partition is loaded.】

[LPL air transport system starts.】

Chen Zhou's pupils shrank slightly.

The next second.

A large amount of information began to emerge like crazy.

[Current competition area: LPL]

[Current time: 2016 Spring Split]

[Current team: LGDGaming]

[System Core Logic: Influence Difference Model]

[The higher the host influence, the lower the overall LPL influence, and the stronger the system growth.】

Immediately afterwards.

A string of data jumped out.

[LPL Division Influence: 73]

[Host personal influence: 3]

[Current luck difference: -70]

[Current stage: trough period]

[System status: not activated]

Chen Zhou frowned.

"What do you mean?"

The next second.

New words emerge.

[System core formula:]

[Host influence-LPL overall influence=luck difference]

[The higher the difference, the stronger the system reward.】

[When the difference reaches the corresponding threshold, the ability can be unlocked.】

Chen Zhouyi was a little confused at first, but soon his face started to look weird.

Because he suddenly discovered that the logic of this system was very sick.

The stronger you become.

The system rewards more.

But the problem is that if I really help LPL win, LPL's influence will also increase accordingly.
